newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 30-day T-Bill yields 8.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 30-day T-Bill yields 8.55 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, sold 30-day treasury bills worth 2.023 billion taka with the corresponding yield at 8.55 percent against previous 8.38 percent at an auction on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price of the accepted bids was 99.29 per 100 taka against 99.31 previously.

The bank also sold 625 million taka worth of 90-day bills at 8.91 percent against the previous 8.98 percent. The weighted average price of the bids was at 97.82 per 100 taka against 97.81 taka previously.
